installation_order: Do not merge PR263 or PR264 during RC15.
Obtain independent human security review and owner decision to accept all-PR owner-ack governance.
Resolve mandatory-check origin/uniqueness and owner-comment post-green revocation issue; record residual risk if operationally accepted.
Obtain explicit scoped owner authorization for installing only the nonoperative base-trusted guard.
After separate approval, merge only isolated PR264 into main; do not canonicalize science.
Create controlled positive/negative canary PRs to observe actual check SHA, origin and merge blockers.
Configure required pull_request and strict GitHub-Actions-pinned trusted-release-gate in main ruleset only after canary identity is proved.
Revalidate with real failure scenarios, including check-name collisions, comment revocation and owner-authorization re-trigger.
Only later consider separate release PR; repeat scientific and provenance review on exact release tree.
evidence_scope: Current observed public GitHub API and mocked candidate CI only. No real required-check installation, bypass test or independent external audit.
